name: Master Music Manager
author: MrKoby07
description: Sends every play to Master Music Manager as it happens, copies Navidrome's listening history once, and shows the artist texts you write there.

url.title: Master Music Manager address
url.description: How Navidrome reaches Master Music Manager, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:4545 (no slash at the end)

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Made in Master Music Manager under Settings → Navidrome plugin

syncHistory.title: Copy the listening history
syncHistory.description: Copies past plays once, then new ones every 30 minutes as a safety net.

artistInfo.title: Use artist texts from Master Music Manager
artistInfo.description: Also add the plugin to Agents in navidrome.toml, e.g. Agents = "master-music-manager,lastfm,spotify"

http.reason: Send plays and history to your Master Music Manager, and read artist texts from it. Any host, because you choose the address.

scrobbleRetriever.reason: Copy the listening history to Master Music Manager

subsonicapi.reason: Look up song names for the history

kvstore.reason: Remember how far the history copy got
